newest.title: 1811 Prairie's north corner stands as a rock-faced stone pier
items: The north end of 1811 Prairie's front is now a narrow pier of rough-faced brownstone, almost a metre wide. Before, the bay's slanted side ran nearly to the corner and left a strip of plain pale stone there. The 1888 plate, a later photograph and a 1965 survey photograph all show the pier.
The 1965 Historic American Buildings Survey photograph of the Kimball house next door is now a reference picture for 1811. It catches the corner of 1811 across the side yard.
An 1887 sketch said to show 1811's entrance is still not used. Its stair and arches do not match the house's own pictures.
